pages.quiz:
ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Trickster Narratives.

3. When practising Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Reader.

4. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Handwriting: Legibility and Neatness.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Oral Narratives.

7. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns.

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a joining word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

9. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

10. When practising Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation Marks.

12. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Conversational Skills: Polite Language.

14. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. quickly

15. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. goes

16. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 11.4.1 Intensive reading: Dilemma Narratives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
